title: Add academy address to Contact section and Footer

requirements.summary: Display the full academy address in the Contact section's info sidebar alongside existing phone/email details
acceptanceCriteria: The address 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy, Malerna Gaon, Ballabgarh, Faridabad 121004' is visible in the Contact section's info sidebar.
The address is accompanied by a location/map pin icon consistent with the existing cricket-themed design.
The address text uses the same typography and color palette as other contact details in that section.

file_operations.description: Add the academy address 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy, Malerna Gaon, Ballabgarh, Faridabad 121004' to the contact info sidebar. Include a MapPin icon from lucide-react (or an appropriate location icon) alongside the address text. Ensure the address uses the same card styling, typography, and spacing as the existing phone and email contact details. Position the address entry appropriately within the sidebar's contact information list.

requirements.summary: Display the full academy address in the site Footer's contact details area
acceptanceCriteria: The address 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy, Malerna Gaon, Ballabgarh, Faridabad 121004' appears in the Footer alongside existing contact details.
The address is accompanied by a location/map pin icon consistent with the footer's existing icon style.
The address is readable against the footer's background color and follows the established green and gold theme.

file_operations.description: Add the academy address 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy, Malerna Gaon, Ballabgarh, Faridabad 121004' to the contact details section in the footer. Include a MapPin icon from lucide-react (or match the existing icon library used) alongside the address text. Ensure the address text is readable against the footer's background color and follows the same styling as other contact details (phone, email, etc.) in the footer, maintaining consistency with the cricket-themed green and gold color palette.
